Refactor and fix typos in BioRvix API module
Corrected typos in module docstrings and comments for better readability. Refactored the `create_query_list` function to use `BioRvixQuery` instead of `Query` for improved functionality.

Set default value for _result in Query class
The _result field in the Query class is now initialized with a default value of None. This ensures that _result is always defined, even if not explicitly set during object instantiation. The change improves the robustness and reliability of the Query class.

Add function to process query list concurrently
Introduce process_query_list to execute BioRvixQuery instances in parallel using thread_map from tqdm. This enhances efficiency by processing multiple queries simultaneously.

Add QueryFactory and BioRvixQueryFactory classes
Introduce `QueryFactory` as an abstract base class for query creation and processing, and `BioRvixQueryFactory` as a specific implementation using the Singleton pattern. These classes streamline the generation, execution, and result extraction of queries. Additionally, moved related functions to `biorxiv_api.py` while cleaning up redundant code.

Refactor query classes and clean up code
Streamline docstrings and simplify the representation of attributes and methods in `Query` and `BioRvixQuery` classes. Also, alter the type of `VALID_ATTRIBUTES` and remove unnecessary imports.

Refactor QueryFactory and update BioRvixQueryFactory usage
Removed ABC inheritance from QueryFactory and applied Singleton pattern. Updated BioRvixQueryFactory to directly use methods from QueryFactory. Adjusted test cases to reflect these changes and corrected pandas import alias in docstring example.

Fix incorrect import in function example.
Corrected the import alias and dataframe initialization in the docstring example for clarity and accuracy. This ensures proper usage instructions for users referring to the example.

Refactor lock mechanism and add new features.
Reorganized the lock mechanism in Factory classes to improve thread safety and refactored several methods. Introduced new functionalities in the PublishedPrepubArticleMediator and streamlined test cases to improve reliability and readability.

Update mediator and test structures, fix query result handling
Refactor mediator to include DOI conversion utility and remove unused comments. Enhance tests with singleton pattern checks and fix query result handling in data processing. Introduce pprint for better debug output in tests.

Refactor Mediator for improved concurrency control
Updated Mediator to use read-write locks (rwlock) for better concurrency control instead of a simple lock. Enhanced the class to follow the Singleton pattern more robustly and made necessary adjustments to method implementations to work with the new locking mechanism.

Fix singleton initialization and add classpath parameter
Move lock initialization to `__new__` method to ensure it's only done once and remove the incomplete `__init__` method. Also, add `classpath` parameter to the `create_base_object` method for clarity.

Add singleton test to mediator design pattern tests
Added a new test to verify the singleton behavior of PublishedPrepubArticleMediator. Ensured that two instances of the mediator are indeed the same and share the same lock.

Refactor Factory pattern for clarity and type safety
Refactor Factory classes for improved readability and type safety. Added explicit type annotations and clarified the class paths in several factory methods. Also moved and reinstated specialized Factory classes to ensure consistency. Updated related test cases accordingly.

Add read-write locks to Mediator singleton class
Refactor Mediator to ensure thread-safe operations using Reader-Writer locks. Updated tests to validate the presence and initialization of these locks.

Refactor mediator pattern implementation
Improved readability and maintainability of the mediator pattern. Refactored method structures, added logger setup, and streamlined subclass implementations. Enhanced error handling and code formatting for clarity.

Update .gitignore and refactor biorxiv API utility functions
Added entries to .gitignore for .idea and .pytest_cache directories. Refactored utility functions in biorxiv_api.py and associated test files to use more descriptive names for date parsing and JSON data processing.

Refactor process_query_results and related tests
Refactored the `process_query_results` module by consolidating functions into the `QueryUtils` class for improved organization. Updated test cases to use the new `QueryUtils` class methods. This enhances code readability and centralizes utility functions.

Refactor date parsing to use NaTType instead of pd.NaT
Switched the return type of the `parse_date` method to use NaTType from pandas._libs instead of pd.NaT for better type precision. This change ensures that the function's return type is more accurately defined and aligns with the internal representation used by pandas.

Reduce notebook size by removing redundant content
The notebook was streamlined by significantly reducing its size, eliminating unused or repetitive code and markdown cells. This enhances readability and performance, while retaining core functionality and information.

Fix example code to correctly reference class method
Updated the example in the docstring to properly reference the `create_article` method using the class name `BioRvixDatabaseUtils`. This ensures clarity and prevents confusion for developers referring to the documentation.

Add new BioRvix data processing Jupyter Notebook template
This notebook sets up dependencies, queries BioRvix APIs for preprint and published articles, and processes data for analysis. It includes multithreading for API calls, data cleaning, merging, and descriptive analysis to examine publication trends and timelines.
closes UofC-Research/peer-review #2

Refactor class importing logic in factory pattern.
Replace custom class importing logic with utility function `import_class` from `common_functions`. This simplifies the code and removes redundancy, enhancing maintainability. Also, move the `_import_class` logic to the shared utilities module.

Refactor class importing logic in factory pattern.
Replace custom class importing logic with utility function `import_class` from `common_functions`. This simplifies the code and removes redundancy, enhancing maintainability. Also, move the `_import_class` logic to the shared utilities module.
Signed-off-by: Albert Leung <1319401+alby1976@users.noreply.github.com>

Refactor ArticleFactory usage and improve typing annotations.
Updated `get_factory_object` to include proper type annotations for kwargs. Replaced direct imports and redundant calls with cleaner logic, particularly in `get_publication_info` and `valid_link`. Refactored `Query` usage to enhance code readability and maintainability.

Refactor Mediator and integrate ArticleLinkTypeMediator
Refactored the Mediator class to improve encapsulation by defining `_mediator_map` in the class declaration. Added `ArticleLinkTypeMediator` with specialized `add_object` and `get_object` methods to manage articles by link type. Updated references to use an instance of `ArticleLinkTypeMediator` instead of class-level calls.

Add `create_queries` function for generating query objects
The new `create_queries` function dynamically imports a class and initializes multiple query objects based on the provided arguments. Additionally, the `import_class` function has been updated with improved error handling and enhanced documentation.

Refactor and improve database query handling.
Introduced `Query.uri_validator` for validation, cleaned up comments, and added comprehensive docstrings to enhance code clarity and maintainability. Adjusted logic in `crossref.py` and streamlined `BioRvixQuery` execution flow.

Add initial implementation of peer-review analysis pipeline that generated by ChatGPT
This commit introduces core modules and documentation for the pipeline. It includes the pipeline structure, modules for NLP, causal inference, geospatial analysis, meta-analysis, network analysis, and predictive modeling. Comprehensive documentation, test cases, and dependencies are also added.

Revamp project documentation for peer review analysis pipeline
Updated documentation with detailed project title, goals, data sources, pipeline overview, and infrastructure. Clarified analysis metrics, automation features, and visualization/reporting capabilities to reflect the current comprehensive pipeline status.
Previous version as base on model 4o instead of 4.5
